verdict.rationale: The agents tools documentation lists "MCP server" as a tool type, described as an external server for systems that aren't pieces. That indicates Activepieces agents can attach external MCP servers and use their tools, but the evidence is a single brief line. The built-in MCP server and embeddable MCP evidence covers the server role and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented setup/configuration steps for adding an MCP server, supported transports and authentication, details on how MCP tools are discovered and exposed to agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
